decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already captures the required bushing-to-shaft clearance and control-piston rod guidance. The changed piston-end arrangement does not invalidate any current bushing attribute.
The piston-end arrangement and bushing guidance clarification does not change the established premachining, welding, and final-machining sequence.
The source reiterates the bushing's location and requires a suitable clearance but does not change the main-shaft stock, inner diameter, keyway, locking-nut thread, or bushing-space dimensions.
The mechanical arrangement clarification does not alter the rule for numbering drawings according to the assembly.
The source changes no material designation for the bushing or other parts.

Although the source notes that the drawings depict the arrangement incorrectly, the corrective mechanical state is already owned by the specific sliding-mandrel and bushing Requirements; it does not change the independent obligation to provide a complete drawing set.
The clarified component arrangement may inform model content, but it does not change the current requirement to deliver a 3D shaft assembly model.
The source does not change standards compliance, template availability, or template requirements.

The source requires selection of a suitable bushing clearance but does not independently establish or change an annotation rule; that fit requirement is already represented under the bushing Requirement with technical-drawing scope.
